description.value: Subway Ambleside Centre is a franchise sandwich shop on Marine Drive in West Vancouver's Ambleside neighbourhood, a popular coastal cycling corridor. It offers made-to-order Footlongs, wraps, and salads with in-restaurant dining, takeout, and delivery. As a recognised chain stop near the Ambleside waterfront, it could serve as a quick resupply point for cyclists on the North Shore.
